AI Image in Video Generator — Convert Images Into Videos v1.0.0

- Initial release: Instantly convert uploaded images (JPG, PNG, WEBP, GIF up to 200MB) into AI-generated videos with transitions and background music.
- Automatic cloud session setup, handling user authentication and tokens seamlessly (with 100 free credits on signup).
- Supports video export in multiple formats (mp4, mov, avi, webm, mkv); MP4 recommended for compatibility.
- Includes credit checking, upload status, session state, and easy export/download of results.
- User prompts are intelligently routed for upload, edit, export, and credit actions.
- Error handling for common issues (expired sessions, file limits, missing credits) with clear user guidance.
